LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_OutpostDesc: A fortified artillery outpost that fires mortar shells at distant hostile settlements, and (when Auto Attack is enabled) intercepts passing enemy caravans. Shell strength is set in mod options and increased by outpost upgrades; accuracy uses the best shooter’s Shooting level; cooldown shortens with total Shooting across the garrison.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_LaunchDesc:
Pick a hostile settlement, caravan, or WD traveler within {0} tiles.
If the shell hits, it deals {1} strength.
Hit chance uses your range-band settings from the outpost options, plus one percentage point per Shooting level of the best shooter ({2}).
Cooldown is shortened by total garrison Shooting ({3}): each point is −2% duration, stacking with upgrades (minimum 25% of base days).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_LaunchDescCooldown: Mortar is reloading — ready in {0} days.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_LaunchDescNoSkill: No shooting skill available at this outpost.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_ReasonNoSkill: Requires at least one pawn with shooting skill
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_AutoAttackDesc: Automatically fires at hostile caravans in range when not Off. Uses the same cooldown and combat rules as the launch gizmo: range bands, best shooter accuracy, upgrade hit bonuses, and Shooting-based cooldown reduction.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_Hit_Traveler_Text: A mortar shell from {0} destroyed the hostile {1}.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_Miss_Text: A mortar shell from {0} fired at {1} fell wide of its mark.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Log_MortarLaunched: {0} launched a mortar strike at {1} ({2} strength).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarRangeTooltip: Maximum world distance (tiles) for manual mortar targeting and for defensive auto-fire range checks.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_CooldownMortarDaysToolti: Base days before a player artillery outpost or hostile T4 interceptor can fire again, before garrison Shooting (2% shorter per summed point, min 25% of this) and outpost upgrade reductions.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarBaseShellDamageToo: Strength removed on a hit before outpost upgrades. Upgrades add flat damage per built level via XML (mortarShellDamageBonus). Settlements split damage across offensive/defensive pools; caravans and WD travelers use one abstract pool.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand0To50: Hit chance at 0–50% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand0To50Toolti: Base hit for 0-50% of max range. With the level-20 best shooter bonus (+20 pp), hit chance reaches 100% at half max range. Upgrades add mortar hit chance bonus.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand51To75: Hit chance at 51–75% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand51To75Toolt: Base for 51-75% of max range (tuned with the inner and outer bands so longer shots stay harder at the same skill).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand76To100: Hit chance at 76–100% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarHitBand76To100Tool: Base for 76–100% of max range; best shooter still adds +1% per level and upgrades stack on top.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Outpost_RapidResponseOffenseBonus: Extra offensive strength cap for Rapid Response Outposts. Future upgrades add flat percentage points on top of this value.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Outpost_RapidResponseRecoveryBonu: Extra offensive recovery speed for Rapid Response Outposts. Future upgrades add flat percentage points on top of this value.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Outpost_RapidResponseAutoRangeToo: Maximum world-tile distance for automatic Rapid Response virtual counter-caravans. Drawn as a purple ring while the outpost is selected.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Outpost_RapidResponseDropPodRange: Maximum world-tile distance for manual Rapid Response pawn drop-pod dispatch from the Pawns tab.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Outpost_RapidResponseSpeedMultToo: Ticks per move multiplier for virtual Rapid Response / settlement-ambush counter-caravans. Lower values make them faster than normal WD travelers. Interceptors also get an extra ~10% chase speed so they can catch targets moving at a similar pace.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_DropPodTicksPerMoveToolt: World ticks per tile for ballistic drop-pod travelers (raids and drop-pod deliveries). Lower = faster. Does not affect Rapid Response virtual counter-caravans (use the travel time multiplier below).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarShellTicksPerMove: Mortar shell travel ticks per tile
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_MortarShellTicksPerMoveT: World ticks per tile for mortar shell travelers on the world map. Lower = faster shells.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_FlakShellTicksPerMove: Anti-Air flak travel ticks per tile
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_FlakShellTicksPerMoveToo: World ticks per tile for Anti-Air flak shells. Lower = faster. Also used when leading moving targets.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_NpcMortarDamageTooltip: Strength removed from hostile tier-4 settlements when their defensive mortar hits a traveler or caravan.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_NpcMortarSkillEquivalent: Treated as the settlement’s “best shooter” level: adds this many percentage points to hit (+1% per point) after distance bands. No outpost upgrades apply to NPC shots.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_InterceptionScanInterval: Shared performance setting. Player artillery and Rapid Response outposts use this interval. Enemy T4 settlements use three times this interval (capped scans per cycle).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_EnableAllTooltip: Master toggle. When on, tier-4 enemy settlements act as defensive mortar interceptors: they fire at hostile NON-player WD travelers in range, and when none are in range they shell the nearest hostile settlement. Whether they may also target YOU is the separate option below.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_MinTechTip: Only factions at this tech level or higher may use T4 settlement mortars and anti-air. Neolithic allows essentially all factions.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_TargetPlayer: May target your WD travelers and outposts
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_TargetPlayerTooltip: When on, enemy T4 mortars may also fire at your WD caravans and outposts, but only while Late Game is active. With this off, they never target you in Late Game. Mid Game has its own toggle; turning Mid Game on forces this Late Game toggle on.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_RangeTooltip: Maximum world distance (tiles) an enemy T4 settlement mortar can reach. Independent of the player artillery range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_CooldownTooltip: Days between shots for an enemy T4 settlement mortar. Independent of the player artillery cooldown.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand0To50: Hit chance at 0–50% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand0To50Tooltip: Base hit chance for T4 mortar shots at 0–50% of max range, before the equivalent shooting-skill bonus.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand51To75: Hit chance at 51–75% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand51To75Tooltip: Base hit chance for T4 mortar shots at 51–75% of max range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand76To100: Hit chance at 76–100% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_HitBand76To100Tooltip: Base hit chance for T4 mortar shots at 76–100% of max range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_ScanSharedNote: Player artillery and Rapid Response outposts use it as-is. Enemy T4 settlements use three times this interval to save performance.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4Mortar_DisabledHint: Enemy T4 settlement mortars are disabled.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_MortarTab_CooldownClampTip: Skill and upgrade reductions cannot shorten cooldown below {0}% of the base duration (minimum {1} days at current base).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_MortarTab_MultiplierFloorLine: Effective duration multiplier: {0}% of base (see header cooldown).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_MortarTab_BestShooterLine: Best Shooter (Shooting {0}): +{1}% hit (flat per level from mod)
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Mortar_AutoAttackDescWithAA: Automatically fires at matching hostile caravans in range. With the Anti-Air Gun upgrade, also engages hostile drop-pod raids (separate short cooldown).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_AutoDesc: When on, automatically engages hostile drop-pod raids, mortar shells, and transport pods in Anti-Air range. Separate from mortar auto-target; uses the Anti-Air cooldown. Red/orange/yellow rings show Anti-Air accuracy vs pods and aerials; mortar shells use a flat shot-down chance.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_UpgradeDropPod_Destroyed_: {0}'s anti-air shot down an outpost upgrade drop pod ({1}). The upgrade materials are lost.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_GoodsDropPod_Destroyed_Te: {0}'s anti-air shot down a goods drop pod ({1}). The shipment is lost.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_RapidResponsePawnsKilled_: {0}'s anti-air destroyed a drop pod. The following pawns died:\n\n{1}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirBaseDamageTooltip: Strength removed from a hostile drop-pod raid on a successful flak hit, before mortar shell upgrades.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_CooldownAntiAirSecondsTo: Base seconds between Anti-Air engagements. Reduced by Shooting skill and mortar cooldown upgrades, then floored.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirCooldownFloorSeco: Minimum Anti-Air cooldown after skill and upgrade reductions.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirDamageTip: Flak resolver damage (base anti-air + shell upgrades).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirCooldownT: Effective anti-air cooldown in seconds after cumulative Shooting and mortar cooldown upgrades (then absolute floor).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirAccTip: Anti-Air hit chance vs drop pods, transport pods, and aerials by distance band (fraction of Anti-Air max range). Band base plus best shooter (+1 pp per Shooting level). Mortar shells use the flat Anti-Air vs shells chance below.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_GroupDesc: Letter group for AA exclusivity. Same letter may keep firing at a claimed target. Other letters are blocked. Off means ungrouped (never claims, never blocked).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_MortarShell_Destroyed_Tex: Anti-Air guns of your Outpost '{0}' have destroyed a mortar shell from the Settlement '{1}' of Faction '{2}'.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_MortarShell_Destroyed_Npc: Anti-Air guns of '{0}' have destroyed a mortar shell from the Settlement '{1}' of Faction '{2}'.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_MortarShell_Miss_Text: {0}'s flak barrage missed a mortar shell from {1}.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_PlayerMortarShell_Destroy: A mortar shell from your outpost {0} was shot down by {1} ({2}).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_PlayerMortarShell_Miss_La: Enemy flak missed your mortar shell
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_PlayerMortarShell_Miss_Te: Flak from {1} ({2}) missed a mortar shell from your outpost {0}.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_VanillaPods_Wiped_Text: {0}'s flak destroyed {1}. The following pawns died:\n\n{2}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_VanillaPods_Wounded_Text: {0}'s flak hit {1}: {2} killed, {3} wounded. Survivors continue.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_VanillaPods_Wounded_WithN: {0}'s flak hit {1}: {2} killed, {3} wounded. Survivors continue. The following pawns died:\n\n{4}
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_VfAerial_AaWarning: Your aerial vehicle might get intercepted by anti-air fire from {0}. Launch anyway?
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_TransportPods_AaWarning: Your transport pods might get intercepted by anti-air fire from {0}. Launch anyway?
LanguageData.TSA_WD_AntiAir_Shuttle_AaWarning: Your shuttle might get intercepted by anti-air fire from {0}. Launch anyway?
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirRangeTooltip: Maximum world distance for Anti-Air engagements. Independent of mortar range. Red, orange, and yellow rings on the map are Anti-Air accuracy bands vs drop pods, transport pods, and aerials (not mortar shells).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand0To50: Anti-Air hit chance at 0–50% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand0To50Toolt: Base Anti-Air hit vs drop pods, transport pods, and aerials at 0-50% of Anti-Air max range. Best shooter adds +1 percentage point per Shooting level. Does not apply to mortar shells.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand51To75: Anti-Air hit chance at 51–75% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand51To75Tool: Base Anti-Air hit vs pods and aerials at 51-75% of Anti-Air max range. Best shooter still adds +1% per level. Mortar shells use the flat Anti-Air vs shells chance instead.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand76To100: Anti-Air hit chance at 76–100% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirHitBand76To100Too: Base Anti-Air hit vs pods and aerials at 76–100% of Anti-Air max range. Best shooter still adds +1% per level. Mortar shells use the flat Anti-Air vs shells chance instead.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_Settings_AntiAirVsMortarHitChance: Anti-Air hit chance vs mortar shells
Flat chance to destroy a hostile mortar shell on an Anti-Air engage (after the reaction delay). Ignores Anti-Air range bands and shooter skill.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirRangeTip: Current anti-air range (may be set below max).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirVsMortarT: Flat chance to destroy hostile mortar shells. Ignores Anti-Air range bands and shooter skill.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_AntiAirGroupTip: Letter group for anti-air exclusivity (Off = ungrouped).
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostStats_Row_MortarAccTip: Band base hit chance + best shooter (+1pp/Shooting level) + hit-chance upgrades.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4_HoverMortarRangeDesc: Hover this command to draw this settlement's T4 mortar range on the world map. Not a toggle.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4_HoverAARangeDesc: Hover this command to draw this settlement's T4 Anti-Air range on the world map. Red, orange, and yellow rings are Anti-Air accuracy bands vs pods and aerials (mortar shells use a flat shot-down chance). Not a toggle.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4_AutoMortar_Desc: When on, this T4 settlement auto-fires its mortar at hostile ground targets in range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4_AutoAA_Desc: When on, this T4 settlement auto-engages hostile airborne targets in AA range.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_EnableAllTooltip: Master toggle for T4 settlement anti-air against hostile airborne targets.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_TargetPlayer: AA may target your airborne assets
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_TargetPlayerTooltip: When on, T4 AA may engage your drop pods and shells while Late Game is active. Mid Game has its own toggle; turning Mid Game on forces this Late Game toggle on.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_RangeTooltip: Maximum AA engagement range for enemy T4 settlements.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_DamageTooltip: Flak resolver damage for T4 settlement anti-air.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_SkillTooltip: Equivalent Shooting skill used for T4 Anti-Air hit bands vs drop pods, transport pods, and aerials (+1 percentage point per level). Does not affect the flat Anti-Air chance vs mortar shells.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand0To50: T4 Anti-Air hit chance at 0–50% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand0To50Tooltip: Base T4 Anti-Air hit vs pods and aerials at 0-50% of Anti-Air max range. Skill equivalent adds +1 percentage point per level. Does not apply to mortar shells.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand51To75: T4 Anti-Air hit chance at 51–75% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand51To75Tooltip: Base T4 Anti-Air hit vs pods and aerials at 51-75% of Anti-Air max range. Mortar shells use the flat T4 Anti-Air vs shells chance instead.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand76To100: T4 Anti-Air hit chance at 76–100% of max range
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_HitBand76To100Tooltip: Base T4 Anti-Air hit vs pods and aerials at 76–100% of Anti-Air max range. Mortar shells use the flat T4 Anti-Air vs shells chance instead.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_VsMortar: T4 Anti-Air hit chance vs mortar shells
LanguageData.TSA_WD_T4AA_VsMortarTooltip: Flat chance for T4 Anti-Air to destroy a hostile mortar shell. Ignores Anti-Air range bands and skill equivalent.
LanguageData.TSA_WD_OutpostUpgrades_BenefitAntiAirUnl: Unlocks anti-air turret vs. drop pods and shells
